title: This tour was great.  While the...
text: This tour was great. While the description might be a little vague on activities our group certainly saw and experienced sites we would never have found on our own. The trip started with a prompt pick up of our group with a drop off for the river cruise. We we were taken up and down the Guadalquivir River, visited the Basílica de la Macarena, and the Torre del Oro. author: Josh S

title: Well organised
text: Good tour with friendly and knowledgeable guide. Original date had to be cancelled due to military parade and tour operator phoned hotel and re-booked for later date. Cruise gave good views of city (though you can't see much of the Expo site due trees) and two vists to Macarena Church and Bullring (monastery closed on Mondays) were interesting.

title: This was a nice way to experience my...
text: This was a nice way to experience my first day in Seville. The guide was very friendly and funny. We started with a boatride, and afterwards visited the bullfighting rink of Seville, which was not expected and a very interesting experience. How many people can say they have actually been inside a bullfighting rink?
author: Sandra M
